label: B25-RX-OBSERVABILITY-BOARD-INTERACTION
title: Volatile-configure the RX observability SOF and close JTAG-UART interaction
scope: After T-010 seals the SOF, program only FPGA volatile SRAM, attach the exact JTAG-MPSSE device 1 instance 0 console, capture startup/periodic RXDBG, and send deterministic status, PING, diagnostic and printable-echo input. Preserve a content-addressed golden volatile rollback path.
acceptance: The exact T-010 SOF configures successfully and the same first console session proves target output plus host-to-target status/PONG/diagnostic/echo. RXDBG classifies any remaining RX failure without guessing.
authorization: User explicitly authorized Quartus and JTAG volatile programming/testing earlier in this bring-up session. This does not authorize persistent Flash, reset or power actions.
resource: Every GamePC/JTAG action acquires gamepc and treats the cable as exclusive. Start/stop only task-owned processes by recorded PID; preserve standard jtagserver PID 5640 unless current identity proves it changed naturally.
forbidden_regions: JIC/EPCQ/Flash write or erase and all persistent formats
power cycle, board/SoC reset or physical manipulation
broad process-name termination or stopping unknown/pre-existing processes
unverified SOF, cable, device or instance substitution

result.command_responses: FAIL; no status, PONG, diagnostic response or Z echo
